title: HarmonyOS Version of Alipay Upgraded and Launched AI Assistant Abao Now Open for Public Testing Across All Platforms
excerpt: On August 13, the HarmonyOS version of Alipay received a major update, officially launching its AI-native assistant "Abao" for public testing to HarmonyOS users
content_html:
On August 13, the HarmonyOS version of Alipay received a major update, officially launching its AI-native assistant "Abao" for public testing to HarmonyOS users. Users only need to update the Alipay app to the latest version in the Huawei AppMarket, and then experience "Abao" by swiping right on the home screen or clicking the bottom-left button. This update marks that "Abao" has achieved full-scene coverage across the three major mobile operating systems: iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS.

As the core carrier of the Alipay ecosystem reconstruction, "Abao" was first launched in June this year and was fully rolled out on June 16th, completely overturning the traditional menu-based click model with natural language interaction. In the HarmonyOS ecosystem, users can simply use conversational expressions to call thousands of services including dining and travel, top-ups and payments, home cleaning, and government affairs with just one sentence, significantly shortening the multi-level click operation path in traditional apps.

Currently, the number of HarmonyOS 6 devices has exceeded 70 million and is showing an accelerating growth trend. By deeply integrating the AI assistant into the HarmonyOS ecosystem, Alipay not only demonstrates its strategic determination to reconstruct the service model of large-scale apps with AI, but also provides billions of terminal users with a more efficient and accurate service access point. As AI-native interactions are widely deployed across mainstream operating systems, the mobile internet service supply is undergoing a paradigm shift from "people seeking services" to "AI scheduling services on demand."

content_html_zh:
8月13日，鸿蒙版支付宝迎来重大更新，正式向鸿蒙用户推出AI原生助手“阿宝”公测。 用户只需在华为应用市场将支付宝应用更新至最新版本，即可在主屏幕右滑或点击左下按钮体验“阿宝”。 此次更新标志着《阿宝》实现了跨iOS、Android、HarmonyOS三大移动操作系统的全场景覆盖。

作为支付宝生态重构的核心载体，“阿宝”于今年6月首次上线，并于6月16日全面上线，彻底颠覆了传统的基于菜单的自然语言交互点击模式。 在HarmonyOS生态中，用户只需用一句话就能调用餐饮出行、充值支付、家庭保洁、政务等上千种服务，大大缩短了传统应用中的多级点击操作路径。

目前，HarmonyOS 6设备数量已突破7000万台，并呈现加速增长趋势。 通过将AI助手深度融入HarmonyOS生态，支付宝不仅彰显了用AI重构大型应用服务模式的战略决心，也为亿万终端用户提供了更高效、精准的服务接入点。 随着AI原生交互在主流操作系统中的广泛部署，移动互联网服务供给正在经历从“人寻求服务”到“AI按需调度服务”的范式转变。
